structured.reason: SchemaSpec.parse takes any object, so a decoded JSON mapping can reach the parser. The original turns that mapping into the requested model with model_validate. The mutant sends it to _extract_json_payload and model_validate_json instead, which expect text. That breaks rebuilding the requested Pydantic model from valid JSON output.
